meta.name: CULL
meta.description: Brutal Intelligence: the gap between Supermoney and MyMind. Every value here is enforced by a test. Do not hardcode a value in a widget; add it here and regenerate.

color._note: Charcoal, never pure black: a slight blue-violet cast lets the violet blobs read as intentional rather than as dirt. Ink is warm off-white, because pure white on a dark canvas vibrates.

canvas_deep.role: Roast card ground, and any place that must feel like a held breath.

canvas_lift.role: One step off the ground, for alternating rows.

surface_4.role: Highest glass layer: modals, the cull confirmation.

ink_mono.role: Receipts: dates, domains, scores. Mono is truth.

ink_disabled.role: Disabled only. Must never carry meaning alone.

signal.role: The acid lime. A signal, not decoration (philosophy 2).

signal_dim.role: Signal for hairline borders where full lime is too loud.

focus.role: Focus ring. Always visible, never removed.

scrim.role: Behind modals and the cull confirmation.

hoardBand._note: The guilt ramp. Rendered as the ScoreDial ring, never as the category pill, so the two scales never compete. Graveyard is the loudest stop on purpose.

category._note: Eight categories, eight hues. Lightness varies as well as hue so the set survives colour blindness: two colours that differ only in hue collapse to one. Every _surface is a very dark tint of its own hue, so hue text on hue surface clears AA without a second colour.

type._note: Editorial, not systematic (philosophy 4). Serif has opinions, so it headlines. Sans is neutral, so it explains. Mono is truth, so it carries dates, domains and scores. Display sizes are fluid between min and max on the viewport.

display.note: Self-host. Falls back to Georgia, not to a system sans.

display-xl.use: Roast card headline. Never in the app body.

mono-xs.use: Week numbers. The smallest text in the app, and still legible.

space._note: 4pt base grid. The irregular offsets in the hoard come from the layout, not from off-grid values.

radius._note: 40px and up on primary surfaces (philosophy 3). CULL has no sharp corners on anything a user can hold.

glass._note: Four named levels of frosted glass (philosophy 6). The border-light is what sells the edge: a translucent fill alone looks like a flat panel.

shadow._note: Gravity (philosophy 6). Large, soft, low-opacity, and offset downward. A card should settle, not appear. Never a hard drop shadow, and never more than two layers.

motion._note: Three tiers, because gravity needs numbers (philosophy 6). Anything longer than 520ms feels like the app is broken. Every duration has a matching reduced-motion value, and design_test.go asserts the pairing.

settle.use: Cards entering, sheet present, the ScoreDial count-up.

dramatic.use: The roast card reveal, full-screen transitions.

standard.use: Everything that moves in and out of a place.

emphasized.use: Values that overshoot and settle: the dial, the blob.

accelerate.use: Exits. Getting out of the way should feel quick.

springSoft.use: The one overshoot in the app. Used once per screen, maximum.

reducedMotion.use: When prefers-reduced-motion is set: zero duration, no blob drift, no dial count-up. The score still renders, immediately.

grain._note: Paper texture over everything (philosophy 6). Generated, not shipped as a binary: design/grain.go writes a 128px tile so the source is reviewable and the weight is tunable.

blob._note: Parametric, not bitmaps (philosophy 3). Four seeds, each a closed Catmull-Rom loop through jittered points on a circle. Regenerate with a new seed rather than drawing a new PNG.
